title: In terms of the fastest lap time, what is the name of the race which record
question:
In terms of the fastest lap time, what is the name of the race which recorded the fastest lap speed by a racer?
Benchmark knowledge evidence: Fastest lap speed refers to MIN(fastestLapTime)

prediction.sql:
SELECT r.XCL_069
FROM results AS res
JOIN races AS r ON res.XCL_074 = r.XCL_065
WHERE res.XCL_088 IS NOT NULL
  AND res.XCL_088 != ''
ORDER BY res.XCL_088 ASC
LIMIT 1;
